    Player Bio - Müller

    Müller is a professional footballer from Germany. He is a 176cm | 5'9" tall, right-footed striker (ST) who plays for EA FC ICONS in Icons. He was born on 03-11-1945.

    FC 27 Base Icon - Müller

    Müller's Icon card is rated 92. He has a 4-star weak foot and 4-star skill moves. He does not have a real face in-game. He has been used in 3,331 games with a GPG (goals per game) of 1.843. He has been used in 413 games with a GPG (goals per game) of 1.799. The best chemistry style for him is Hunter. The best chemistry style for him is Engine. Müller has 1 special card with rating 92.

    His current price on FUT is 1,040,000 on PlayStation, 1,040,000 on Xbox, and 1,300,000 on PC.
